oil.when: 2019 with the small information display and a select/reset knob in the gauges
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the service shown has been done).
Turn the ignition to ON without starting the engine.
Press the select/reset knob in the gauge cluster repeatedly until the engine oil life shows.
Press and hold the knob for 10 seconds or more, until the oil life and maintenance codes blink.
Press and hold the knob again for 5 seconds or more. The codes clear and the oil life goes back to 100%.

oil.when: 2019 with the multi-information display and SEL/RESET button
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the service shown has been done).
Turn the ignition to ON without starting the engine.
Use the up and down arrow buttons to select Maintenance Info., then press SEL/RESET.
Use the arrows to select Reset, then press SEL/RESET. The maintenance codes clear and the oil life goes back to 100%.
oil.note: Choose Cancel and press SEL/RESET to leave without resetting.
